record.hypothesis: Untie history-input and target-output item embedding tables while retaining unit L2 normalization, width 128 and exactly zero padding in both. Initialize the output table as a copy of the input table, then train both jointly within each category's single GRU4Rec model. Separate embedding roles may reduce conflicting gradients between recurrent encoding and candidate discrimination. Preserve GRU topology, history policy, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer across all four datasets; update checkpoint loading and the predictor writer.
